description: This file defines a final class `DefaultMdcEntry` implementing the `MdcEntry` interface. It provides a way to create and manage key-value pairs for logging context or diagnostics, with methods to instantiate, access, and compare entries.

classes.name: DefaultMdcEntry
classes.description: An immutable class representing a key-value pair used for MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries in logging.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of `DefaultMdcEntry` with a key and optional value.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key for this MDC entry.

methods.name: getValueOrNull
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the key, or null if none.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on key and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the instance.
